annotations.title: Add a Doctor parlay to the slip

description: Put one of the Doctor’s posted parlays (key from get_doctor_parlays) on this account’s slip in one step, with a unique commandKey. Checks every leg’s current price at the parlay’s book, saves the parlay as a private unplaced ticket and returns its legs (marketSelectionId, oddsAmerican, line, eventId) and ticketId; counts one tail per account per parlay. Same paid-leg lock as get_doctor_parlays; never places a bet. Keep the caller-generated commandKey (16-120 characters) stable for this action and all retries. Action and version are fixed by this tool; do not supply them.
name: add_doctor_parlay_to_slip
title: Add a Doctor parlay to the slip
